contract.task_clause:
Characteristic X rays, appearing as sharp lines on a continuous background, are produced when high-energy electrons bombard a metal target. Which of the following processes results in the characteristic X rays?
Option A: Electrons producing Čerenkov radiation
Option B: Electrons colliding with phonons in the metal
Option C: Electrons filling inner shell vacancies that are created in the metal atoms
Option D: Electrons combining with protons to form neutrons
